preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 2 and 250,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and 1 <= c <= 10**6 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect valid vertices and have a positive weight.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n integers.
All output integers must be non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[x]) <= total_weight for x in range(n))
postconditions.description: The total weight of deleted edges for each x must not exceed the total weight of all edges.
